messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel

message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Station name** | **Miami Central Station** (also known as the *Miami Intermodal Center*) | | **Address** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | | **Phone** | (305) 284‑4000 | | **Hours** | 24 / 7 – the station is open around the clock for passengers and their pets | | **Pet policy** | • **Amtrak** (Silver Service & Silver Meteor) allows small pets in carriers (≤ 20 lb) for free.
• Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• No pets allowed on the train if they exceed the weight limit or are not in a carrier.
• The station itself has a dedicated **pet relief area** (dog‑friendly restroom) located near the main entrance, so you can give your dog a quick break before boarding. | | **Amenities for pets** | • Pet relief area (dog‑friendly restroom)
• Nearby cafés and shops that accept pets (check with each vendor)
• Amtrak’s “Pet Friendly” policy is clearly posted at the station and on the Amtrak website | | **Nearby public transport** | • Miami Intermodal Center connects to the Metrorail (Metrorail’s Miami Central Station), the Metrobus system, and the Tri-Rail commuter rail (though Tri‑Rail does not serve Miami Central).
• The station is also a hub for rideshare pickups and taxi stands. | | **How to confirm** | • Call the station at (305) 284‑4000 or visit the Amtrak website for the latest pet‑policy updates.
• If you’re traveling on a different train service (e.g., a private rail company), call them directly to confirm their pet rules. | ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Your Pet 1. **Carrier** – Bring a sturdy, well‑ventilated carrier that meets Amtrak’s size and weight limits. 2. **Documentation** – Keep a copy of your pet’s vaccination records handy in case staff ask. 3. **Arrival** – Arrive early to give yourself time to use the pet relief area and settle in. 4. **During the trip** – Keep your pet in the carrier at all times; only take it out for a quick bathroom break if the train’s schedule allows. **Bottom line:** The Miami Central Station (Miami Intermodal Center) is the most convenient and pet‑friendly train hub in Miami, offering both a pet relief area and Amtrak’s pet‑friendly policy. Enjoy your trip!
